patch.value: Fix SDK GetItemProjection id drift breaking dependency-refresh release:check
dev dependency @unbrained/pm-cli ^2026.8.14; lockfile pins 2026.8.14; npm update --save resolves to 2026.8.17

1) npm ci (installs 2026.8.14 from lockfile); 2) npm update --save (resolves @unbrained/pm-cli to 2026.8.17); 3) npm run build:test -> TS2322 at test/vcs-commands.test.ts:188 and :189; 4) npm run release:check fails at the build:test step.

The weekly Dependency Refresh workflow runs npm update --save (resolving @unbrained/pm-cli to the latest ^2026.8.x, currently 2026.8.17), then npm run release:check, and opens a refresh PR when changed.

release:check fails at npm run build:test with: test/vcs-commands.test.ts(188,34): error TS2322: Type '{}' is not assignable to type 'GetItemProjection'. Property 'id' is missing in type '{}' but required in type '{ id: string; ... }'. Same error repeats at line 189.

value.text:
Dependency-refresh release:check failure — investigation and repair.

FAILING RUN
https://github.com/unbraind/pm-vcs/actions/runs/31993254790 (Dependency Refresh -> release:check)

REPRODUCTION (clean install from lockfile, then the exact refresh sequence)
1. npm ci  -> installs @unbrained/pm-cli 2026.8.14 (lockfile pin); npm run build:test passes.
2. npm update --save  -> resolves @unbrained/pm-cli to 2026.8.17 (within ^2026.8.14).
3. npm run build:test  -> TS2322 at test/vcs-commands.test.ts:188 and :189:
   "Type '{}' is not assignable to type 'GetItemProjection'. Property 'id' is missing in type '{}' but required in type '{ id: string; ... }'."
4. npm run release:check  -> fails at the build:test step.

ROOT CAUSE
The SDK tightened the get-projection contract between 2026.8.14 and 2026.8.17.
node_modules/@unbrained/pm-cli/dist/sdk/query/get.d.ts:
- 2026.8.14: type GetItemProjection = Partial<ItemMetadata> & { body?, notes_count?, tests_count?, collection_counts? }  (all optional)
- 2026.8.17: type GetItemProjection = Partial<ItemMetadata> & { id: string; body?, notes_count?, tests_count?, collection_counts? }
  with the new required member documented as "Canonical item identity retained by every depth and field projection."
GetResult.item is GetItemProjection, so a fabricated { item: {} } no longer satisfies the contract. This is a backward-compatible tightening for real consumers: production code only ever consumes GetResult from PmClient.get(...), whose projections always carry id, and linkedFiles() reads only result.linked?.files. The break is confined to test fixtures that fabricated an incomplete projection.

DETERMINATION (pin update vs fixture correction vs both)
Fixture correction only — not a pin update. The required id is a legitimate SDK guarantee the runtime already upholds; pinning the dev dependency back to silence the type (or casting with any/unknown) would hide the contract rather than satisfy it. The dependency-refresh workflow owns the version bump; this repair only restores compatibility, so the package.json range and lockfile stay at ^2026.8.14 / 2026.8.14.

FILES CHANGED
- test/vcs-commands.test.ts: the "linkedFiles normalizes omitted SDK linked projections" test fabricates GetResult literals; both now carry item: { id: "linked-files-item" } so the projection satisfies the SDK contract while the linked group remains the part under test.

CALL-SITE / RUNTIME-PATH REVIEW
- vcs-commands.ts linkedFiles(result: GetResult) reads result.linked?.files ?? []; no item-field access, no fabricated projections in production.
- vcs-commands.ts:482 (vcs files) and :506 (vcs changes) call pmClient(context).get(item, { full: true }) and pass the real GetResult to linkedFiles; unaffected.
- No production source constructs GetResult literals; the only fabrication site was this test. grep for "item: {}" / GetResult literals across test/, scripts/, *.ts, engine/ returned only these two lines.

TEST PLAN
- npm run build:test (typecheck tests) at 2026.8.17: passes with the fix.
- Mutation proof at 2026.8.17: reverting the fixture back to { item: {} } reproduces TS2322 at :188 and :189; restoring the fix makes build:test pass. A test that passes both implementations is therefore ruled out.
- Full npm run release:check at 2026.8.17 (typecheck/build/lint/duplicates/docstring/coverage/accept:native-toon/accept:stat-cache/accept:self-host/audit:prod/audit:identities/pack:dry-run/changelog:check): exit 0.
- Coverage gate c8 --all --100: All files 100 / 100 / 100 / 100.

DEPENDENCY EVIDENCE
- package.json devDependency: "@unbrained/pm-cli": "^2026.8.14".
- package-lock.json node_modules/@unbrained/pm-cli: 2026.8.14.
- npm view @unbrained/pm-cli version: 2026.8.17.
- 2026.8.17 dist/sdk/query/get.d.ts declares the required id member; 2026.8.14 does not.

WORKTREE / BRANCH
Isolated git worktree /tmp/pm-vcs-projection-drift-worktree on branch agent/repair-pm-vcs-projection-drift (from origin/main c043e77). Local commit only; no push, PR, release, or workflow change.
